question: I love the SWORD members so much that I want to know their ages and other profiles. Are Prince and Kujaku from the same generation as Captain Drake?
answer: It's hard to say what exactly a profile is, but things like age and height seem like a good start. More detailed character data can be found in the Vivre Card - One Piece Visual Dictionary. I don't mean to be mean and not write about it in the SBS so you have to buy it, but I physically can't compete with you in terms of the amount of information. I'll answer if you ask, so please forgive me. [Name · Drake · Kujaku · Grus · Koby · Hibari · Helmeppo  ||  Rank · Former Rear Admiral · Rear Admiral · Rear Admiral · Captain · Commander · Lieutenant Commander  ||  Age · 33 years old · 26 years old · 29 years old · 18 years old · 17 years old · 22 years old  ||  Height · 233 cm (7'8") · 180 cm (5'11") · 205 cm (6'9") · 167 cm (5'6") · 165 cm (5'5") · 179 cm (5'10")] *Kujaku and Grus are slightly younger than Drake, but in terms of their relationship, they're almost like classmates. Also, I've had people ask me if Grus was a prince from somewhere, but he's not. He's just rich and posh. D: Here are the results of counting the number of times a certain word was said by Oda in the SBS, from volumes 4 to 106. #Poop -> 13 times #Breasts (and variations) -> 19 times #Penis (and variations) -> 36 times What on Earth is the SBS? (15-years-old) O: Okay... uh... that's a lie, right? (sweats) I really don't remember. If I had to guess, it would be Sanada. To me, SBS is a pure space, like a quiet forest with sunlight filtering through the trees, playing with the birds and squirrels... So... don't count a second time!! (huff!) (unfair anger) Oh, there's a postcard from a child! They didn't mention their age, so maybe they're in elementary school? Feel free to ask any questions.
name: Taranome
